capabilities: Highlight non-ASCII characters in Live Preview and Reading view
Batch-replace common non-ASCII characters with ASCII equivalents via the command palette
Configure find/replace rules and an allowlist of excluded characters
Disable highlighting per note through frontmatter
Show a non-ASCII character count in the status bar
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Invisible Unicode characters, accidental special characters, and non-standard punctuation are hard to spot in Obsidian notes.
summary: Character checker that highlights non-ASCII characters with a red background in edit and reading views and can batch-replace them with ASCII equivalents.
